newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, wheat flat, nearby soy down.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, wheat flat, nearby soy down.

text.p: FOB Gulf corn and wheat basis values were steady while nearby soybean prices were weaker, but some strength was noted in deferreds, export sources said.

Brokers noted very little movement in wheat markets as world supplies grew and demand shrank. While U.S. stocks remained relatively tight, world production levels had increased, meaning traditional importers relied less on U.S. wheat, a broker said.
"The supply and demand situation just isn't favorable for the wheat market," a broker said. "If you don't have the constant export demand you can't keep the market going."
Brokers noted Egypt was looking for 30,000 tonnes each optional origin corn and soybeans for November shipment.
USDA on Wednesday reported sales of 500,000 tonnes U.S. corn to Egypt.
